name: whisper-vulkan-addon
description: Experimental Vulkan (MoltenVK) Whisper.cpp Node.js addon for SmartScribe (Intel macOS).

scripts.prepare:whisper: test -d third_party/whisper.cpp || git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp third_party/whisper.cpp
scripts.build: npm run prepare:whisper && cmake-js build && node scripts/post-build-copy.js
